scientific_question: How does experience-replay performance change as the expected replay target-Jacobian covariance is progressively erased while preserving every replay target multiset?

interpretation.analysis_role: outcome-informed but prospectively locked fresh-seed dose-response follow-up
interpretation.strength_parameter: For replay batch size n and lambda>0, m=1+round_half_up(lambda*(n-1)); uniformly select m positions and uniformly permute targets within them. The exact expected covariance-erasure strength is lambda_n=(m-1)/(n-1). Lambda=0 is identity and lambda=1 is the original full uniform permutation distribution.

inference.primary_statistic: within-replica OLS slope of final accuracy over the five requested lambda levels, followed by averaging four slopes within seed; lambda=0 is shared across replicas
inference.primary_intervals: two-sided Student-t 95 percent interval over 12 seed-level slopes with a nested Monte Carlo variance floor
inference.nested_variance_floor_role: conservative finite-Monte-Carlo guard, not an exact hierarchical variance model
inference.primary_family: two benchmark-specific slope tests with Holm correction
inference.negative_supported_slope_interpretation: graded negative trend, not proof of monotonicity
inference.monotonicity_claim_rule: all four pooled adjacent point-estimate differences must be nonpositive
inference.secondary_usefulness_family: ten benchmark-by-strength contrasts of ER against the same-seed no-replay reference, Holm corrected
secondary_outputs: all strength-specific accuracies and pointwise intervals
V_total, V_perm, and V_pair at the binary endpoints
